result.roast: $WETH: known major asset (WETH). Buy and sell simulate cleanly.

reasons.message: Simulated buy, transfer and sell on uniswap_v3 succeeded with no token tax

liquidity.method: approx: 2 x quote-side pool balance x Chainlink price. Uniswap v4 and DEXs not listed are not covered.

holders.top_holders_note: a full top-holder list needs an indexer; not included (free public sources only)

result.notice: Informational only, not financial advice. Automated on-chain heuristics and a simulated trade; they can miss risks and can flag safe tokens.

free_tier.note: demo token: free, full result and not counted
free_tier.then: x402: $0.01 USDC on Base per check at https://tokencheck.madebydevx.com/v1/token/verdict?chain=base&address=0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006 (this endpoint also returns the x402 quote once the free checks are used)

upgrade.message: Full report for $0.01: repeat this request with an x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or X-PAYMENT) here or at https://tokencheck.madebydevx.com/v1/token/verdict?chain=base&address=0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006.
upgrade.value: One $0.01 call before a swap: a simulated buy, transfer and sell against the token's own pool with taxes, privileged functions, holders and liquidity, summarized as safe/caution/danger with reasons. Failed or empty checks are never charged.

offer.gasless: You sign an EIP-3009 USDC authorization; the Coinbase CDP facilitator submits it. The wallet needs 0.01 USDC on Base and no ETH.
paid_adds: buy, sell and transfer tax % from the simulated trade, plus pool, gas and revert reason
every reason (the free tier shows the top 3)
privileged functions found in the bytecode (mint, blacklist, pause, fee setters, ownership)
holder concentration (owner, creator, burned, in-pool %) and deployer (creator, creation tx, tx count)
liquidity per pool and DEX, Sourcify verification detail, checks run and data sources
AX1-compatible envelope (roast, metrics), a 7-day receipt (status_url), a share page and card image
idempotent recovery: replay the same signed request or requestKey and get the stored verdict with no second charge
offer.comparison: AX1 Verdict (ax1.vc) quotes $0.02 per call in its live x402 402 (checked 2026-10-23); DevX Token Check is $0.01 and accepts the same request body.

next_steps.how: Sign the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402 v2, eip155:8453) or accepts[0] in this body (x402 v1, network "base") and repeat this exact request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1). Any stock x402 client does this automatically; see snippets.

next_steps.note: full paid-format result for 4 demo tokens (USDC, WETH, DEGEN, AERO on Base), free
optional and opt-in: we store only what you send, use it only for Token Check API/price change notices, and you can delete it with the returned token

snippets.@x402/fetch (Node, x402 v2): import { wrapFetchWithPayment, x402Client } from "@x402/fetch"; import { registerExactEvmScheme } from "@x402/evm/exact/client"; import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts"; const c = new x402Client(); registerExactEvmScheme(c, { signer: privateKeyToAccount(process.env.EVM_PRIVATE_KEY) }); const r = await wrapFetchWithPayment(fetch, c)("https://tokencheck.madebydevx.com/v1/token/verdict?chain=base&address=0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006"); console.log((await r.json()).result.verdict);
snippets.x402-fetch (Node, x402 v1): import { wrapFetchWithPayment } from "x402-fetch"; import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts"; const r = await wrapFetchWithPayment(fetch, privateKeyToAccount(process.env.EVM_PRIVATE_KEY))("https://tokencheck.madebydevx.com/v1/token/verdict?chain=base&address=0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006"); console.log((await r.json()).result.verdict);
snippets.python x402 (v2): from x402 import x402ClientSync; from x402.http.clients import x402_requests; from x402.mechanisms.evm.exact.register import register_exact_evm_client; from x402.mechanisms.evm.signers import EthAccountSigner; from eth_account import Account; c = x402ClientSync(); register_exact_evm_client(c, EthAccountSigner(Account.from_key(KEY))); print(x402_requests(c).get("https://tokencheck.madebydevx.com/v1/token/verdict?chain=base&address=0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006").json()["result"]["verdict"])
